content.short: Slowmist is a blockchain security firm offering security audits, red teaming, and security consulting.
content.description: Slowmist is a blockchain ecosystem security firm that protects blockchain applications through independent cybersecurity audits and ongoing defense. It delivers security audits, threat intelligence (BTI), bug bounty programs, defense deployment, and security consultancy. Slowmist also runs cryptocurrency AML, a false top-up scanner, a vulnerability scanner, and vulnerability monitoring (Vulpush), along with hacked project archives (SlowMist Hacked) and a smart contract firewall (FireWall.X). These offerings help projects identify risk, prevent exploits, and maintain secure operations across diverse ecosystems.
